business_summary: Tanac Automation Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells of automated electromechanical equipment, automation systems, automated machinery, and electronic and mechanical components in China and internationally. The company offers winding equipment, such as wireless charging coil, VCM, voice coil, transformer/relay, inductor, heating wire, and capacitive pen core coil, as well as LED dispensing and assembly, flexible cable assembly, CG film lamination, and housing graphite lamination equipment; production lines, including heating wire winding testing and packaging, inductor winding assembly and testing, electric toothbrush motor coil, stud welding and assembly, laptop bonding and installation, traction valve assembly, and fully automatic transformer winding, coating, soldering, and testing machines. It also provides pin and valve winding equipment, segmented motor winding equipment, fly fork winding equipment, straight-line winding equipment, automotive SMD transformer winding equipment, reversing radar sensor winding equipment, automotive EPS motor, automotive brake motor, automotive thermal management system, condenser fan motors, compressor, electronic suspension, SMD transformer, wiper motor assembly, cooling motor winding and assembly, carbon canister solenoid valve, door handle induction coil, and automotive seat motor production lines. In addition, it offers linear motor winding equipment, hollow cup motor winding equipment, capillary precision winding equipment, connector assembly equipment, I-beam inductor winding equipment, small surface mount inductor winding equipment, frameless torque motor, servo motor, hollow cup motor, articulated module, and thermal fuse production lines; and other products; as well as after-sales services. The company serves consumer electronics, home appliances, and automotive industries. It exports its products. Tanac Automation Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Jiashan, China.
